confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Turkish Aegean resort pricing, not checked against live menus, rates or listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately certain; peak-July accommodation is least certain given seasonal swings. Turkish lira inflation and depreciation make 2026 price levels uncertain. Beer assumed to be about a 0.5 L draft. Cocktail and wine anchors were set from local beer-relative pricing (about 2x and 1.5x draft beer) because direct knowledge is weak. FX figure taken from search-result summaries citing the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Turkish Riviera resorts such as Marmaris, Fethiye and Kalkan for restaurant and hotel levels, with Greek Dodecanese islands such as Kos and Rhodes as an upper reference across the water. Prices are adjusted down for lower Turkish price levels and up for July peak demand. Region is set to Europe, the usual grouping for Turkey's Aegean and Mediterranean resort market, although Bodrum itself lies in Anatolia.
